PluginData.Author: Bunio
PluginData.Tooltip: Your grid's data in windows on the HUD, plus inventory logistics: sorting, refineries, autocrafting.
PluginData.Description:
Live data of the grid you sit in, drawn on the HUD: power, cargo, ores, ingots, refineries, autocrafting, block details. Automatic LCDs 2 style elements, no LCD panels needed. Per-grid profiles and named window templates.
Logistics (runs while you sit in the grid): - Sorting into Ores / Ingots / Components / Tools / Ammo / Bottles containers, special containers. - Refineries: your ore order, every ore split equally. - Ice and uranium balancing. - Autocrafting by limits, split across all assemblers. - Optional small PB script keeps refineries balanced 24/7.
Quick start: sit in a cockpit and type /data in chat. Polish and English.
Guide and bugs: https://github.com/bunio80/DaneHud
